title: Get started with rthologs
text: Use orthologs() find orthologs set genes. Give genes, source species genes, target species. result standard data frame one row input matching gene pair. source_ columns identify input gene. target_ columns identify ortholog. support column lists sources support pair support_n column gives number sources. source target can two species package.
code: result <- orthologs("TP53", source = "human", target = "mouse") dplyr::glimpse(result) #> Rows: 1 #> Columns: 11 #> $ input             <chr> "TP53" #> $ source_taxon_id   <int> 9606 #> $ source_symbol     <chr> "TP53" #> $ source_ncbi_id    <chr> "7157" #> $ source_ensembl_id <chr> "ENSG00000141510" #> $ target_taxon_id   <int> 10090 #> $ target_symbol     <chr> "Trp53" #> $ target_ncbi_id    <chr> "22059" #> $ target_ensembl_id <chr> "ENSMUSG00000059552" #> $ support           <chr> "HGNC|Hieranoid|InParanoid|OMA|OrthoFinder|OrthoInsp… #> $ support_n         <int> 9 result <- orthologs("Trp53", source = "mouse", target = "rat") dplyr::glimpse(result) #> Rows: 1 #> Columns: 11 #> $ input             <chr> "Trp53" #> $ source_taxon_id   <int> 10090 #> $ source_symbol     <chr> "Trp53" #> $ source_ncbi_id    <chr> "22059" #> $ source_ensembl_id <chr> "ENSMUSG00000059552" #> $ target_taxon_id   <int> 10116 #> $ target_symbol     <chr> "Tp53" #> $ target_ncbi_id    <chr> "24842" #> $ target_ensembl_id <chr> "ENSRNOG00000010756" #> $ support           <chr> "Ensembl Compara|Hieranoid|InParanoid|OMA|OrthoFinde… #> $ support_n         <int> 9

title: Get started with rthologs
text: input can gene symbols, NCBI IDs, Ensembl IDs. Inputs case-sensitive can mix input types one vector. input direct match can match gene synonym. Synonyms include previous symbols, CTGF CCN2. use primary names, set synonyms = FALSE.
code: genes <- c("TP53", "7157", "ENSG00000141510") result <- orthologs(genes, source = "human", target = "mouse") result[, c("input", "source_symbol", "target_symbol")] #>             input source_symbol target_symbol #> 1            TP53          TP53         Trp53 #> 2            7157          TP53         Trp53 #> 3 ENSG00000141510          TP53         Trp53 genes <- c("CTGF", "SEPT7") result <- orthologs(genes, source = "human", target = "mouse") result[, c("input", "source_symbol", "target_symbol")] #>   input source_symbol target_symbol #> 1  CTGF          CCN2          Ccn2 #> 2 SEPT7       SEPTIN7       Septin7

title: Get started with rthologs
text: input can one ortholog. ortholog gets row. default, result includes best matches. get orthologs data, set best = FALSE. keep pairs support, set min_support.
code: genes <- c("Ptprc", "Hba-a1", "Gapdh") result <- orthologs(genes, source = "mouse", target = "zebrafish") result[, c("input", "target_symbol", "support_n")] #>    input target_symbol support_n #> 1  Ptprc         ptprc         8 #> 2 Hba-a1       hbae1.1         8 #> 3 Hba-a1         hbaa2         8 #> 4  Gapdh         gapdh        10 result <- orthologs(   "Hba-a1",   source = "mouse",   target = "zebrafish",   best = FALSE ) result[, c("input", "target_symbol", "support_n")] #>    input target_symbol support_n #> 1 Hba-a1       hbae1.1         8 #> 2 Hba-a1         hbaa2         8 #> 3 Hba-a1         hbae4         4 result <- orthologs(   "Hba-a1",   source = "mouse",   target = "zebrafish",   best = FALSE,   min_support = 6 ) result[, c("input", "target_symbol", "support_n")] #>    input target_symbol support_n #> 1 Hba-a1       hbae1.1         8 #> 2 Hba-a1         hbaa2         8

title: Get started with rthologs
text: default, result include inputs orthologs. keep inputs, set orthologs_only = FALSE. inputs gets one row NA columns. Cd34 valid mouse gene, data contain zebrafish ortholog . Fakegene mouse gene.
code: genes <- c("Ptprc", "Cd34", "Fakegene") result <- orthologs(   genes,   source = "mouse",   target = "zebrafish",   orthologs_only = FALSE ) result[, c("input", "target_symbol")] #>      input target_symbol #> 1    Ptprc         ptprc #> 2     Cd34          <NA> #> 3 Fakegene          <NA>

title: Get started with rthologs
text: orthologs come Alliance Genome Resources (AGR). AGR combines predictions sources: PANTHER, SonicParanoid, OrthoFinder, Ensembl Compara, OrthoInspector, InParanoid, PhylomeDB, OMA, Hieranoid, HGNC, ZFIN. package uses AGR stringent set includes: Pairs three methods support, best match least one direction. Pairs two methods support, best match directions. pairs HGNC ZFIN. package includes eight species orthologs species data. use data, please cite AGR: Alliance Genome Resources Consortium. Updates Alliance Genome Resources central infrastructure. Genetics. 2024. doi: 10.1093/genetics/iyae049.

title: Gene Orthologs for Model Organisms
text: rthologs maps genes orthologs species. Supports common model organisms, including human, mouse, zebrafish, fly. Looks genes symbol, NCBI (Entrez) ID, Ensembl ID. Returns matches tidy R data frame can filter, summarize, join data. Works offline.

title: Find gene orthologs — orthologs
text: genes character vector gene symbols NCBI/Ensembl gene IDs (case-sensitive). source Species genes, "mouse". See species(). target Species find orthologs. synonyms TRUE (default), check gene synonyms inputs direct match. best TRUE (default), keep best matches, can differ search directions. min_support Minimum number methods sources support gene pair. Use one positive whole number. maximum possible count depends species pair. orthologs_only TRUE (default), keep inputs least one matching pair.

title: rthologs: Gene Orthologs for Model Organisms — rthologs-package
text: Genomic analysis frequently involves comparisons human mouse data. requires harmonization gene names gene space. 'rthologs' R package simplifies cross-species conversion mapping gene orthologs/homologs common model organisms human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, fly. supports gene symbols, NCBI (Entrez) IDs, Ensembl IDs, works offline. orthologs sourced Alliance Genome Resources (AGR) doi:10.1093/genetics/iyae049 .
